blocks.goal: Extract the cohesive pretty-printing and concrete-syntax interpretation responsibility from LexicalPreservingPrinter while preserving its public API and behavior.

ops.details: Move prettyPrintingTextNode and interpret, including their concrete-syntax-model traversal and primitive/comment/modifier formatting logic, into the new same-package helper. Update LexicalPreservingPrinter.getOrCreateNodeText(Node) to delegate creation and formatting to the helper while continuing to expose the existing package-visible method and public NODE_TEXT_DATA field. Pass NODE_TEXT_DATA into the helper rather than changing the public field or introducing a dependency from the helper back to LexicalPreservingPrinter. The target no longer directly references ConcreteSyntaxModel, CsmElement, CsmIndent, CsmMix, CsmToken, CsmUnindent, or NodeWithVariables; these references are confined to the helper. LexicalDifferenceCalculator remains required by the target's Observer and existing field, while JavaToken, Node, NodeText, Difference, VariableDeclarator, and comment-related types remain required elsewhere in the target. The target gains one new outgoing dependency, LexicalPreservingPrinterTextHelper, while eliminating seven distinct direct dependencies, for an expected net Fan-Out reduction of six. Preserve all existing formatting branches and delegation behavior.
